rate_table_note: Rates are in NAC 690A.155(2)(a) to (f), printed as "95 cents", "79 cents", "67 cents", "$1.23", "$1.03" and "86 cents". Joint is 1.85 times single (4). Insurers must file the formula their rates are based on (1).
source_title: NAC chapter 690A, Credit Insurance (Nevada Legislature; sections added by R014-06, eff. 4-1-2007; amended by R145-08, eff. 9-18-2008)
summary: Rates in force: Nevada's credit unemployment rates deemed reasonable in NAC 690A.155(2): 95 cents per $100 per annum single premium; 79 cents per $1,000 of remaining principal balance or 67 cents per $1,000 of remaining payments monthly; and higher rates for 90-day lump-sum benefits. The section was last amended by R145-08, effective September 18, 2008; whether that amendment changed these figures was not checked, so September 18, 2008 is the date the current text took effect.
